state.persona: Anonymous first-time visitor to dope.travel (a travel discovery site), on an iPhone-sized phone, no account, no prior knowledge of the product vocabulary. Wants to find a place worth going to, understand why and how far, and keep it for later.
state.job: Find a place worth going to and understand why and how far.
state.workflow: On the home page (phone) they chose New York as their city, chose Fall and Culture & food, and tapped the first shortlist card 'Munich · Oktoberfest · Fly there on the globe'. The globe flew to Munich.
state.visible: THIS IS YOUR DESTINATION. Munich, GERMANY / CULTURAL. Oktoberfest. Sixteen days on the Theresienwiese, fourteen big tents, six breweries and no substitutes. 19 Sep – 04 Oct 2026 · Theresienwiese. WHAT MAKES IT WORTH THE TRIP: Six breweries, litre steins, and a rule that you must be seated to drink; Käfer's gallery stays open past the tents and is where Munich actually sits. NEW YORK → MUNICH. 6,490 km · ~8h 30m in the air. Primary button 'Open Munich ↗'; link 'Start a Circle here →'. Small print: Editorial event details; verify dates and access with organizers. Distance and airtime are indicative, not a flight schedule.
state.context: Today is 24 Sep 2026, so Oktoberfest is already under way.
